description: This file contains an extension to the `OnboardingView` SwiftUI view, defining multiple methods for user interactions within a macOS application related to onboarding, gateway selection, settings, navigation, and copying text to the pasteboard.

methods.name: selectLocalGateway
methods.description: Sets the connection mode to local, clears preferred gateway ID, hides advanced connection options, and resets preferred stable ID.

methods.name: selectUnconfiguredGateway
methods.description: Cancels ongoing onboarding tasks, sets connection mode to unconfigured, clears preferred gateway ID, hides advanced connection options, and resets preferred stable ID.

methods.name: selectRemoteGateway
methods.description: Handles selection of a remote gateway, updates preferences, applies remote selection support, and updates connection mode and gateway ID.

methods.name: openSettings
methods.description: Requests opening a specified settings tab, triggers the UI to display settings, and posts a notification to switch UI to the selected tab.

methods.name: handleBack
methods.description: Navigates back in the onboarding page sequence with animation.

methods.name: handleNext
methods.description: Advances to the next onboarding page if not blocked; completes onboarding if on last page.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Marks onboarding as seen, records the current onboarding version, and closes the onboarding view.

methods.name: copyToPasteboard
methods.description: Copies given text to the system clipboard and provides visual feedback by temporarily setting a 'copied' flag.
